answer: The echo index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the ocean queue while honest agents promoted earlier continues earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 400 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the atlas. Honest users pay that once, farms 15 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
